title: carex binervis var. ovata

It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
